thread:
marta_cs: Morning team — starting CedarFold onboarding thread. Goal: pilot -> gated prod in ~3 weeks. Need owners for SSO, data pipeline, cost checks, and an exec-ready demo. Can we confirm?

simon_impl: Hi! I can lead integration (SSO + data export). Quick ask: Do they require SCIM for user provisioning or just SAML for SSO?

arya_eng: We prefer SAML only unless they explicitly ask for SCIM. Also, we need expected concurrent sessions for the pilot to size worker pools.

nina_pm: CedarFold said "light interactive" for pilot but some batch embedding jobs overnight. For success criteria: (A) functional SSO + CSV export; (B) embedding p95 < 2s; (C) cost per 1k tokens < target we set after baseline. Exec demo must show cost delta vs their incumbent.

todd_renewals: Adding context: Renewal due Q4. Biggest risk: opaque token costs. We'll need a small cost-runbook and a one-pager for their finance lead.

marta_cs: Proposed owners: Marta = CS lead, Simon = integration lead, Arya = eng perf owner, Nina = PM/customer liaison, Todd = renewal/exec liaison. Any conflicts?

simon_impl: fine. I'll prepare an "integration artifacts" doc: IdP metadata checklist, export schema (CSV fields), retention policy. Will ask CedarFold for sample rows.

arya_eng: Noting a technical risk: CedarFold sometimes sends inputs with multi-thousand token system prompts. We should include model selection guidance and a test comparing full precision vs 4-bit quantized for cost/latency. Tag as "cost-eval".

todd_renewals: Suggest we include a small A/B cost comparison in Week 1 to reduce renewal risk. If quantized output quality is acceptable, we lock recommended config for production.

nina_pm: I'll collect the usage profile and the list of endpoints they plan to call from product. Also will coordinate anonymization of prompt samples — they prefer we provide a sanitization script.

marta_cs: I'll ask CedarFold to anonymize and return a prompt set. I'll also book a sync after our internal prep.

calendar-bot: Event created: "CedarFold Internal Onboard Sync" Thursday 9am PT — invite sent to participants.

simon_impl: For data export, they requested daily CSV. We'll scope webhook for a later phase. Do we need to confirm encryption at rest and transfer?

marta_cs: Yes — security checklist item for their SCC: TLS for transfer and AES-256 at rest. Simon add to confluence.

arya_eng: Perf plan: I'll spin up a staging route and run two 24h passes: (1) interactive profile, (2) overnight batch embedding. Need sample traffic shape from Nina.

nina_pm: Sending sample shapes in a follow-up DM.

todd_renewals: Action list for today: 1) Simon: integration doc + data contract (EOD). 2) Arya: staging perf plan + quick A/B test template. 3) Nina: traffic profile + anonymization instructions. 4) Marta: request IdP metadata + prompt set anonymized + finance contact. 5) Todd: renewal one-pager draft.

marta_cs: Great. I'll coordinate customer ask and confirm owners before the internal sync. Thanks everyone :clap:
